notes.title: Steam Update – New Languages & Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We're continuously working to expand the game’s reach by adding more language options. However, we are committed to maintaining high-quality localization and have chosen [i]not[/i] to rely on AI-generated translations especially for major languages where quality is critical. Instead, we’re hiring human translators and proofreaders through Fiverr, which incurs additional cost but ensures a better experience for players worldwide.[/p][p]In this update, we're excited to roll out [b]Turkish[/b], [b]Italian[/b], and [b]French[/b] language support! We’ve also implemented a series of minor bug fixes and stability improvements based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and as always, more is coming.[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Dear players,

We would like to inform you that we are releasing a small patch for My Bimbo Dream on Steam, which fixes a recently identified issue.

The problem affected some players (5-10% of you), preventing them from starting the game properly. This bug occurred because, in some cases, the game was collecting old data from players who had access to previous test versions, causing conflicts and preventing the game from working as intended.

We are happy to report that this issue has been resolved in the new update, ensuring that new players will no longer encounter this problem.

[b]Important![/b]

For players who are still experiencing this issue, it is essential to follow these steps:

Keep the game open.

- Navigate to the save directory: [i]Steam\steamapps\common\My Bimbo Dream\game\saves[/i]

- Completely delete all files inside that folder.

- Close the game and then open it again.

-- Please note that the game must be open when you delete the save files.

This procedure will ensure that the game works correctly.

We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your understanding and continued support. We are always working to provide the best experience possible!

Sincerely,
The Dev Team

notes.title: Team and Development Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have some exciting updates to share about the team and the progress on the game!

First, we’re thrilled to announce two new additions to the team who are already making a big impact Eroguysensei and Drive. Eroguysensei is focusing on creating and polishing the main environments of the game for Season 2 as well as create renders for S2EP1. He’s adding detail and perfecting the overall look of the game, which is already improving the visual quality. Meanwhile, Drive is working on rigging and animations, transferring assets from Daz3D to Maya to make the animations more professional and smooth. Their combined expertise is helping us take the game to the next level.

On the development side, the posing for Episode 10 Part 2 is nearly finished thanks to Cus, who has been doing a fantastic job. There’s still some work left to do, but the finale is really coming together. At the same time, work on Season 2 Episode 1 is already underway, and the first renders are coming through. It feels a bit strange to see the start of a new season before finishing the last, but the goal is to release both around the same time — aiming for the end of April/Start of May.

We’re excited about the direction things are heading, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon.

More updates coming soon!

Jim and Sinburn

notes.title: Developers Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We’re hard at work on Episode 9 of My Bimbo Dream, which will be available to our Patrons next month. This episode is the second to last in the season, so get ready for some major developments as we approach the season finale and the Steam release!

In addition, we’ve been going back to rework some of the early game images to ensure a more cohesive visual style throughout. This includes redone animations, and we’re incredibly proud of the improvements—everything feels smoother and more polished. We can’t wait for you all to experience the enhanced visuals for the steam release!

Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to release.

notes.title: Development Update: Season 1... What will it include?
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to share some details about our progress and plans for the game’s upcoming Steam release!

[b]Season 1[/b] of the game will include all episodes from 1 to 10, giving you a complete experience from start to finish. In preparation for the Steam release, Episodes 1-3 will undergo a complete revamp, including improved visuals (renders + animations) and additional scenes to enrich the overall experience. These updates are going to be specifically for the Steam version, so the early game will feel fresh and more polished than ever.

As for this month on patreon, we’ll be releasing Episode 8. Overall, we’re currently about 60-65% through the game’s development. Our focus is on polishing the game as much as possible before launching it on Steam, ensuring that it meets our high standards.

Thank you,

- The team
